label: Article 5
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to acquire Information on the full identity, the legal grounds, the purpose of the request and the use of Personal Data, and the accountability of the party requesting the Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 6
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to complete, update, and/or rectify errors and/or inaccuracy of Personal Data concerning him/her according to the purpose for which the Personal Data is processed.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 7
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to have access to and obtain a copy of Personal Data concerning him/her in accordance with law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 8
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to end the processing, erase, and/or destroy Personal Data concerning him/her in accordance with law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 9
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to withdraw the consent to the processing of Personal Data concerning him/her that has been given to the Personal Data Controller.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 10
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 11
text: A Personal Data Subject shall have the right to postpone or restrict the processing of Personal Data in proportion to the purpose for which the Personal Data is processed.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 66
text: Any Person is prohibited from producing falsified Personal Data or falsifying Personal Data with intent to benefit themselves or other persons to cause harm to other persons.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 67
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 68
text: Any Person who intentionally makes false Personal Data or falsifies Personal Data with intent to benefit themselves or other persons to cause harm to other persons under Article 66 shall be sentenced to imprisonment of up to 6 (six) years and/or a fine of up to Rp6,000,000,000.00 (six billion rupiah).
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 69
text: In addition to the sentence under Articles 67 and 68, an additional sentence may be imposed as seizure of profits and/or assets acquired or the proceeds from a criminal offense, and payment of compensation.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 74
text: Upon this Law coming into effect, Personal Data Controllers, Personal Data Processors, and other parties in connection with the processing of Personal Data must adjust their practice to the provisions for processing of Personal Data under this Law within 2 (two) years of its promulgation as Law.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 75
text: Upon this Law coming into effect, all the provisions of laws and regulations that stipulate Personal Data Protection are declared to remain in effect to the extent they do not contravene the provisions of this Law.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

label: Article 76
text: This Law shall come into effect from the date it is promulgated. In order that everyone may be aware of it, the promulgation of this Law is ordered by placement in the State Gazette of the State of the Republic of Indonesia.
